failures.root_cause: sw-e2e-integration-test failed because a stale pipeline lock (pipeline-1798) from a prior interrupted run was still held, so the fast pipeline test could not acquire it; the other two failures (sw-intent-analysis-test missing JSON schema fields, sw-loop-test stuckness detection) are unrelated pre-existing defects
failures.fix: Release/clear stale pipeline locks before the e2e-integration test suite runs (or add a lock-cleanup step in test setup/teardown), and separately fix the intent-analysis schema generator and loop stuckness-detection logic

failures.fix: Inspect sw-loop-test.sh and sw-intent-analysis-test.sh failure output directly, fix the specific broken assertions/logic, and add a shorter internal timeout or mock external calls in sw-e2e-integration-test to prevent the 301s hang
